newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Azomures to boost capital base.
newsitem.headline: Romania Azomures to boost capital base.

text.p: Romanian listed fertiliser maker Azomures said on Friday it planned to raise its capital base and revise its 1997 budget in line with forecasts on deliveries to home and foreign markets.
The announcement lifted a suspension on the Bucharest bourse, which halted its shares from first-tier trading on Wednesday pending release of details of July 9 shareholders' meeting.

The meeting agreed in principle to increase capital by around 10 billion lei after a reassessment of fixed assets, Azomures commercial manager Horia Petra said by telephone from Tirgu Mures in the Transylvanian region.
Azomures' share capital now stands at 209.5 billion lei.
Petra said the company's 1997 budget would be revised in line with reduction in fertiliser home sales and exports.
"We expect our 1997 deliveries to fall to around 370,000 tonnes from 460,000 last year due to higher world market prices and to changes in forms of payment at home," Petra said.
"This will modify a lot of indicators under our budget, such as turnover, profit and so on."
State subsidies for the farming sector are being replaced this year by vouchers enabling farmers to purchase seed, fertiliser and implements.
"Farmers this year will have to pay around 150,000 lei for fertiliser per hectare and we therefore expect lower sales," Petra said.
Azomures is one of the most heavily traded stocks on the Bucharest bourse and even performed well last year before activity intensified under a new reformist government. ($=7,122 lei)
